audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for Pharaoh's paired dreams, Joseph's interpretation, seven years abundance/famine, Egyptian elevation, naming, Asenath, Manasseh/Ephraim, and famine administration.

verses.restored: At the end of two full years, Pharaoh dreamed that he was standing by the Nile.

modern.text: After two full years had passed, Pharaoh had a dream: He was standing beside the Nile,

modern.text: In the morning his spirit was troubled, so he summoned all the magicians and wise men of Egypt. Pharaoh told them his dreams, but no one could interpret them for him.

modern.text: Now a young Hebrew was there with us, a servant of the captain of the guard. We told him our dreams and he interpreted them for us individually.

familiar.text: And there shall arise after them seven years of famine; and all the plenty shall be forgotten in the land of Egypt; and the famine shall consume the land;

modern.text: but seven years of famine will follow them. Then all the abundance in the land of Egypt will be forgotten, and the famine will devastate the land.

original.text: וְ֠קָמוּ שֶׁ֜בַע שְׁנֵ֤י רָעָב֙ אַחֲרֵיהֶ֔ן וְנִשְׁכַּ֥ח כָּל הַשָּׂבָ֖ע בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְכִלָּ֥ה הָרָעָ֖ב אֶת הָאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: The abundance will not be known in the land because of the famine afterward, for it will be very heavy.

familiar.text: And the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of that famine following; for it shall be very grievous.

modern.text: The abundance in the land will not be remembered, since the famine that follows it will be so severe.

original.text: וְלֹֽא יִוָּדַ֤ע הַשָּׂבָע֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ מִפְּנֵ֛י הָרָעָ֥ב הַה֖וּא אַחֲרֵי כֵ֑ן כִּֽי כָבֵ֥ד ה֖וּא מְאֹֽד

verses.restored: The dream was doubled to Pharaoh because the thing is established by the Divine, and the Divine will hurry to do it.

familiar.text: And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh twice; it is because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.

modern.text: Moreover, because the dream was given to Pharaoh in two versions, the matter has been decreed by God, and He will carry it out shortly.

original.text: וְעַ֨ל הִשָּׁנ֧וֹת הַחֲל֛וֹם אֶל פַּרְעֹ֖ה פַּעֲמָ֑יִם כִּֽי נָכ֤וֹן הַדָּבָר֙ מֵעִ֣ם הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וּמְמַהֵ֥ר הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים לַעֲשֹׂתֽוֹ

verses.restored: Now let Pharaoh look for a discerning and wise man and set him over the land of Egypt.

familiar.text: Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man discreet and wise, and set him over the land of Egypt.

modern.text: Now, therefore, Pharaoh should look for a discerning and wise man and set him over the land of Egypt.

original.text: וְעַתָּה֙ יֵרֶ֣א פַרְעֹ֔ה אִ֖ישׁ נָב֣וֹן וְחָכָ֑ם וִישִׁיתֵ֖הוּ עַל אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם

verses.restored: Let Pharaoh appoint overseers over the land and take a fifth of the land of Egypt during the seven years of abundance.

familiar.text: Let Pharaoh do this, and let him appoint officers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven plenteous years.

modern.text: Let Pharaoh take action and appoint commissioners over the land to take a fifth of the harvest of Egypt during the seven years of abundance.

original.text: יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה פַרְעֹ֔ה וְיַפְקֵ֥ד פְּקִדִ֖ים עַל הָאָ֑רֶץ וְחִמֵּשׁ֙ אֶת אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם בְּשֶׁ֖בַע שְׁנֵ֥י הַשָּׂבָֽע

verses.restored: Let them gather all the food of these good years that are coming, store grain under Pharaoh’s hand, and keep food in the cities.

familiar.text: And let them gather all the food of those good years that come, and lay up corn under the hand of Pharaoh, and let them keep food in the cities.

modern.text: Under the authority of Pharaoh, let them collect all the excess food from these good years, that they may come and lay up the grain to be preserved as food in the cities.

original.text: וְיִקְבְּצ֗וּ אֶת כָּל אֹ֨כֶל֙ הַשָּׁנִ֣ים הַטֹּבֹ֔ת הַבָּאֹ֖ת הָאֵ֑לֶּה וְיִצְבְּרוּ בָ֞ר תַּ֧חַת יַד פַּרְעֹ֛ה אֹ֥כֶל בֶּעָרִ֖ים וְשָׁמָֽרוּ

verses.restored: The food shall be a reserve for the land for the seven years of famine that will be in Egypt, so the land will not be cut off by famine.

familiar.text: And that food shall be for store to the land against the seven years of famine, which shall be in the land of Egypt; that the land perish not through the famine.

modern.text: This food will be a reserve for the land during the seven years of famine to come upon the land of Egypt. Then the country will not perish in the famine.” Joseph Given Charge of Egypt

original.text: וְהָיָ֨ה הָאֹ֤כֶל לְפִקָּדוֹן֙ לָאָ֔רֶץ לְשֶׁ֨בַע֙ שְׁנֵ֣י הָרָעָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּהְיֶ֖יןָ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְלֹֽא תִכָּרֵ֥ת הָאָ֖רֶץ בָּרָעָֽב

verses.restored: The word was good in the eyes of Pharaoh and in the eyes of all his servants.

familiar.text: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.

modern.text: This proposal pleased Pharaoh and all his officials.

original.text: וַיִּיטַ֥ב הַדָּבָ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֑ה וּבְעֵינֵ֖י כָּל עֲבָדָֽיו

verses.restored: Pharaoh said to his servants, Can we find a man like this, in whom is the spirit of the Divine?

familiar.text: And Pharaoh said unto his servants, Can we find such a one as this is, a man in whom the Spirit of God is?

modern.text: So Pharaoh asked them, “Can we find anyone like this man, in whom the Spirit of God abides?”

original.text: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֖ה אֶל עֲבָדָ֑יו הֲנִמְצָ֣א כָזֶ֔ה אִ֕ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֛ר ר֥וּחַ אֱלֹהִ֖ים בּֽוֹ

verses.restored: Pharaoh said to Joseph, Since the Divine has shown you all this, there is none as discerning and wise as you.

familiar.text: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Forasmuch as God hath shewed thee all this, there is none so discreet and wise as thou art:

modern.text: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Since God has made all this known to you, there is no one as discerning and wise as you.

original.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר פַּרְעֹה֙ אֶל יוֹסֵ֔ף אַחֲרֵ֨י הוֹדִ֧יעַ אֱלֹהִ֛ים אוֹתְךָ֖ אֶת כָּל זֹ֑את אֵין נָב֥וֹן וְחָכָ֖ם כָּמֽוֹךָ

verses.restored: You shall be over my house, and by your mouth all my people shall be ordered; only in the throne will I be greater than you.

familiar.text: Thou shalt be over my house, and according unto thy word shall all my people be ruled: only in the throne will I be greater than thou.

modern.text: You shall be in charge of my house, and all my people are to obey your commands. Only with regard to the throne will I be greater than you.”

original.text: אַתָּה֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה עַל בֵּיתִ֔י וְעַל פִּ֖יךָ יִשַּׁ֣ק כָּל עַמִּ֑י רַ֥ק הַכִּסֵּ֖א אֶגְדַּ֥ל מִמֶּֽךָּ

verses.restored: Pharaoh said to Joseph, See, I have set you over all the land of Egypt.

familiar.text: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, See, I have set thee over all the land of Egypt.

modern.text: Pharaoh also told Joseph, “I hereby place you over all the land of Egypt.”

original.text: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֖ה אֶל יוֹסֵ֑ף רְאֵה֙ נָתַ֣תִּי אֹֽתְךָ֔ עַ֖ל כָּל אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם

verses.restored: Pharaoh removed his signet ring from his hand and put it on Joseph’s hand, clothed him in fine linen garments, and placed a gold chain on his neck.

familiar.text: And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand, and put it upon Joseph’s hand, and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck;

modern.text: Then Pharaoh removed the signet ring from his finger, put it on Joseph’s finger, clothed him in garments of fine linen, and placed a gold chain around his neck.

original.text: וַיָּ֨סַר פַּרְעֹ֤ה אֶת טַבַּעְתּוֹ֙ מֵעַ֣ל יָד֔וֹ וַיִּתֵּ֥ן אֹתָ֖הּ עַל יַ֣ד יוֹסֵ֑ף וַיַּלְבֵּ֤שׁ אֹתוֹ֙ בִּגְדֵי שֵׁ֔שׁ וַיָּ֛שֶׂם רְבִ֥ד הַזָּהָ֖ב עַל צַוָּארֽוֹ

verses.restored: He made him ride in the second chariot, and they called before him, Bow the knee. So he set him over all the land of Egypt.

familiar.text: And he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had; and they cried before him, Bow the knee: and he made him ruler over all the land of Egypt.

modern.text: He had Joseph ride in his second chariot, with men calling out before him, “Bow the knee!” So he placed him over all the land of Egypt.

original.text: וַיַּרְכֵּ֣ב אֹת֗וֹ בְּמִרְכֶּ֤בֶת הַמִּשְׁנֶה֙ אֲשֶׁר ל֔וֹ וַיִּקְרְא֥וּ לְפָנָ֖יו אַבְרֵ֑ךְ וְנָת֣וֹן אֹת֔וֹ עַ֖ל כָּל אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם

verses.restored: Pharaoh said to Joseph, I am Pharaoh, but without you no one shall lift hand or foot in all the land of Egypt.

familiar.text: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I am Pharaoh, and without thee shall no man lift up his hand or foot in all the land of Egypt.

modern.text: And Pharaoh declared to Joseph, “I am Pharaoh, but without your permission, no one in all the land of Egypt shall lift his hand or foot.”

original.text: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֛ה אֶל יוֹסֵ֖ף אֲנִ֣י פַרְעֹ֑ה וּבִלְעָדֶ֗יךָ לֹֽא יָרִ֨ים אִ֧ישׁ אֶת יָד֛וֹ וְאֶת רַגְל֖וֹ בְּכָל אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם

verses.restored: Pharaoh called Joseph’s name Zaphenath-paneah and gave him Asenath daughter of Potiphera priest of On as a woman. Joseph went out over the land of Egypt.

familiar.text: And Pharaoh called Joseph’s name Zaphnathpaaneah; and he gave him to wife Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On. And Joseph went out over all the land of Egypt.

modern.text: Pharaoh gave Joseph the name Zaphenath-paneah, and he gave him Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, to be his wife. And Joseph took charge of all the land of Egypt. The Seven Years of Plenty

original.text: וַיִּקְרָ֨א פַרְעֹ֣ה שֵׁם יוֹסֵף֮ צָֽפְנַ֣ת פַּעְנֵחַ֒ וַיִּתֶּן ל֣וֹ אֶת אָֽסְנַ֗ת בַּת פּ֥וֹטִי פֶ֛רַע כֹּהֵ֥ן אֹ֖ן לְאִשָּׁ֑ה וַיֵּצֵ֥א יוֹסֵ֖ף עַל אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם

verses.restored: Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. Joseph went out from Pharaoh’s presence and passed through all the land of Egypt.

familiar.text: And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.

modern.text: Now Joseph was thirty years old when he entered the service of Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph left Pharaoh’s presence and traveled throughout the land of Egypt.

original.text: וְיוֹסֵף֙ בֶּן שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה בְּעָמְד֕וֹ לִפְנֵ֖י פַּרְעֹ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ מִצְרָ֑יִם וַיֵּצֵ֤א יוֹסֵף֙ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔ה וַֽיַּעְבֹ֖ר בְּכָל אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם

verses.restored: In the seven years of abundance, the earth produced by handfuls.

familiar.text: And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls.

modern.text: During the seven years of abundance, the land brought forth bountifully.

original.text: וַתַּ֣עַשׂ הָאָ֔רֶץ בְּשֶׁ֖בַע שְׁנֵ֣י הַשָּׂבָ֑ע לִקְמָצִֽים

verses.restored: He gathered all the food of the seven years in Egypt and put food in the cities, the food of the fields around each city he put within it.

familiar.text: And he gathered up all the food of the seven years, which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities: the food of the field, which was round about every city, laid he up in the same.

modern.text: During those seven years, Joseph collected all the excess food in the land of Egypt and stored it in the cities. In every city he laid up the food from the fields around it.

original.text: וַיִּקְבֹּ֞ץ אֶת כָּל אֹ֣כֶל שֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר הָיוּ֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וַיִּתֶּן אֹ֖כֶל בֶּעָרִ֑ים אֹ֧כֶל שְׂדֵה הָעִ֛יר אֲשֶׁ֥ר סְבִיבֹתֶ֖יהָ נָתַ֥ן בְּתוֹכָֽהּ

verses.restored: Joseph stored grain like the sand of the sea, very much, until he stopped counting, for it was beyond number.

familiar.text: And Joseph gathered corn as the sand of the sea, very much, until he left numbering; for it was without number.

modern.text: So Joseph stored up grain in such abundance, like the sand of the sea, that he stopped keeping track of it; for it was beyond measure.

original.text: וַיִּצְבֹּ֨ר יוֹסֵ֥ף בָּ֛ר כְּח֥וֹל הַיָּ֖ם הַרְבֵּ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד עַ֛ד כִּי חָדַ֥ל לִסְפֹּ֖ר כִּי אֵ֥ין מִסְפָּֽר

verses.restored: Before the year of famine came, two sons were born to Joseph, whom Asenath daughter of Potiphera priest of On bore to him.

familiar.text: And unto Joseph were born two sons before the years of famine came, which Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On bare unto him.

modern.text: Before the years of famine arrived, two sons were born to Joseph by Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On.

original.text: וּלְיוֹסֵ֤ף יֻלַּד֙ שְׁנֵ֣י בָנִ֔ים בְּטֶ֥רֶם תָּב֖וֹא שְׁנַ֣ת הָרָעָ֑ב אֲשֶׁ֤ר יָֽלְדָה לּוֹ֙ אָֽסְנַ֔ת בַּת פּ֥וֹטִי פֶ֖רַע כֹּהֵ֥ן אֽוֹן

verses.restored: Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh, for he said, The Divine has made me forget all my hardship and all my father’s house.

familiar.text: And Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh: For God, said he, hath made me forget all my toil, and all my father’s house.

modern.text: Joseph named the firstborn Manasseh, saying, “God has made me forget all my hardship and all my father’s household.”

original.text: וַיִּקְרָ֥א יוֹסֵ֛ף אֶת שֵׁ֥ם הַבְּכ֖וֹר מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה כִּֽי נַשַּׁ֤נִי אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת כָּל עֲמָלִ֔י וְאֵ֖ת כָּל בֵּ֥ית אָבִֽי

verses.restored: The name of the second he called Ephraim, for the Divine has made me fruitful in the land of my affliction.

familiar.text: And the name of the second called he Ephraim: For God hath caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction.

modern.text: And the second son he named Ephraim, saying, “God has made me fruitful in the land of my affliction.” The Famine Begins

original.text: וְאֵ֛ת שֵׁ֥ם הַשֵּׁנִ֖י קָרָ֣א אֶפְרָ֑יִם כִּֽי הִפְרַ֥נִי אֱלֹהִ֖ים בְּאֶ֥רֶץ עָנְיִֽי

verses.restored: The seven years of abundance that were in the land of Egypt came to an end.

familiar.text: And the seven years of plenteousness, that was in the land of Egypt, were ended.

modern.text: When the seven years of abundance in the land of Egypt came to an end,

original.text: וַתִּכְלֶ֕ינָה שֶׁ֖בַע שְׁנֵ֣י הַשָּׂבָ֑ע אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיָ֖ה בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם

verses.restored: The seven years of famine began to come, as Joseph had said. There was famine in all lands, but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.

familiar.text: And the seven years of dearth began to come, according as Joseph had said: and the dearth was in all lands; but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.

modern.text: the seven years of famine began, just as Joseph had said. And although there was famine in every country, there was food throughout the land of Egypt.

original.text: וַתְּחִלֶּ֜ינָה שֶׁ֣בַע שְׁנֵ֤י הָרָעָב֙ לָב֔וֹא כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר אָמַ֣ר יוֹסֵ֑ף וַיְהִ֤י רָעָב֙ בְּכָל הָ֣אֲרָצ֔וֹת וּבְכָל אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם הָ֥יָה לָֽחֶם

verses.restored: When all the land of Egypt was hungry, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread. Pharaoh said to all Egypt, Go to Joseph; whatever he says to you, do.

familiar.text: And when all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread: and Pharaoh said unto all the Egyptians, Go unto Joseph; what he saith to you, do.

modern.text: When extreme hunger came to all the land of Egypt and the people cried out to Pharaoh for food, he told all the Egyptians, “Go to Joseph and do whatever he tells you.”

original.text: וַתִּרְעַב֙ כָּל אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וַיִּצְעַ֥ק הָעָ֛ם אֶל פַּרְעֹ֖ה לַלָּ֑חֶם וַיֹּ֨אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֤ה לְכָל מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ לְכ֣וּ אֶל יוֹסֵ֔ף אֲשֶׁר יֹאמַ֥ר לָכֶ֖ם תַּעֲשֽׂוּ

verses.restored: The famine was over all the face of the earth. Joseph opened all that was stored and sold to Egypt, and the famine was strong in the land of Egypt.

familiar.text: And the famine was over all the face of the earth: And Joseph opened all the storehouses, and sold unto the Egyptians; and the famine waxed sore in the land of Egypt.

modern.text: When the famine had spread over all the land, Joseph opened up all the storehouses and sold grain to the Egyptians; for the famine was severe in the land of Egypt.

original.text: וְהָרָעָ֣ב הָיָ֔ה עַ֖ל כָּל פְּנֵ֣י הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיִּפְתַּ֨ח יוֹסֵ֜ף אֶֽת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֤ר בָּהֶם֙ וַיִּשְׁבֹּ֣ר לְמִצְרַ֔יִם וַיֶּחֱזַ֥ק הָֽרָעָ֖ב בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם

verses.restored: All the earth came to Egypt to Joseph to buy grain, because the famine was strong in all the earth.

familiar.text: And all countries came into Egypt to Joseph for to buy corn; because that the famine was so sore in all lands.

modern.text: And every nation came to Joseph in Egypt to buy grain, because the famine was severe over all the earth.

original.text: וְכָל הָאָ֨רֶץ֙ בָּ֣אוּ מִצְרַ֔יְמָה לִשְׁבֹּ֖ר אֶל יוֹסֵ֑ף כִּֽי חָזַ֥ק הָרָעָ֖ב בְּכָל הָאָֽרֶץ
